name: Forward-vol-regime armed fear capitulation: VIX-term backwardation gates an extreme-fear dip buy (PM-vol proxy)
rationale: Thesis: the durable, tradable corollary of the Kalshi prediction-market result (arXiv 2604.01431 — pm repricing forecasts crypto 5-day REALIZED VOL, not direction) is that a forward-looking risk-regime gauge should ARM a contrarian crypto dip-buy only when the regime is genuinely stressed but not yet in free-fall. Real pm_risk_on has ~3 rows (uninvestable), so we substitute the durable PIT proxy with the same forward-vol content: VIX term structure. When vix_term_slope flips into BACKWARDATION (front > back, slope crosses DOWN through ~0) the options market is pricing imminent near-term stress — the forward-vol regime is hot. We ARM only then, and CONFIRM with fear_greed in the extreme-fear band (washed-out sentiment). The edge hedge funds cannot take: (a) the literal pm signal has ~1yr history (uninvestable for them), (b) they trade vol directly via options whereas we are long-only spot, so we use the forward-vol regime to TIME a dip-buy rather than to trade vol. This is regime-GATING (a vol regime ARMS a different entry), not a tired single signal. Low turnover by construction: term-slope backwardation co-occurring with extreme fear is rare. DISCONFIRMER (explicit): the SAME extreme-fear contrarian buy WITHOUT the term-slope arm is already EXHAUSTED (Fear&Greed-alone capitulation FAILED honestly). The disc-* fear-greed-alone control is in the cohort. If the fear-greed-alone net-of-fee deflated Sharpe matches this gated variant, the vix_term_slope backwardation gate adds NOTHING and this is buy-the-dip in disguise — an honest FAIL. A flat/random-arm control would likewise expose it. The deflated-Sharpe + BH-FDR + purged-holdout gate must show the GATED variant survives where the fear-alone ablation dies; if trades are too few to clear the minimum that is honest 'insufficient evidence', not an edge. The Gate disposes.
catalyst: VIX term structure flips into backwardation (forward-vol regime stressed) while crypto Fear&Greed is in the extreme-fear band
